tei:div.tei:p: (817)bhyoḥ phur ba'i srung ma dam tshig can/ bhyo las skyes pa'i shwa na mo/ sa bdag bdag nyid chen mo bzhi/ rang rang rigs kyi ming po dang*/ tshangs dang drang srong srin po dang*/ gnod sbyin grul bum lha klu'i rigs/ 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro ma/ kun kyang khyod kyi rol pa ste/ gcig dang tha (818)dad las 'das pa'i/ snang srid kun khyab shwa na mo/ 'khor 'das gnyis la dbang bsgyur ma/ shwa na'i ma tshogs dam la 'dus/ dam rdzas bka' yi gtor ma longs/ brgyud 'jin slob ma bu bzhin skyongs/ brtan g.yo'i rlung sems brtan pa 'phrog snyan grags gdul bya'i sgo 'phar phyes/ mjad phrin gegs med gong 'phel nas/ don gnyer kun las rgyal kha long*/ nyams pa bdun ldan cham la phob/ snga dgra (819)(820)sems pa rdul du rlog da dgra bde ba phye mar thongs/ bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mjod/

ces pa 'di ni bu 'gyur med rdo rje dbus bskyod kyi mtshan mo'i snang char shwa na mo rnams kyis sprul pa spro bsdu sgyu ma'i bkod pa yig 'phrul bzhin brtses pa'i mthar gcig dang tha dad bral ba'i rdo rje'i glu dbyangs bcas thams cad kyi phyag na ba dan dkar po re re thog nas 'gro bar mthong ba'i tshe dgos dbang gis padma las 'brel rtsal gyis bris pa'o/ maṅga lam/// /
